messages:
leo_growth: FYI Ops flagged a regional issue in eu-central impacting hosted inference. Want to align on status copy + who sends what. Quick thread.

ops-bot: Alert: partial_degradation detected in hosted-api eu-central at 2026-04-02T09:12:xxZ  severity=S2 \\ auto-ticket=#3421

jason_ops: We're isolating one rack, routing traffic away. Error spike ~10% of requests. Working on transparent failover. ETA 20m for stable routing.

amy_marketing: Drafting short public status. Option A (concise): `Investigating: Intermittent 5xx errors for hosted inference in eu-central. Engineers are rerouting traffic; updates every 15 minutes.` Option B (slightly softer): `Partial degradation detected; some requests may fail. We're working on mitigation and will post updates shortly.` Which do we prefer?

emily_support: Lean Option A for clarity. Add a single-sentence SLA note: "If this affects SLA metrics for your org, contact support@example.com and we'll prioritize." Also prep two canned replies (trial customers / enterprise).

nina_legal: Quick note: don't say "data lost" or imply customer data exposure unless confirmed. Also avoid timelines framed as guarantees. The SLA contact phrasing is fine.

leo_growth: Marketing ask: hold any scheduled benchmark tweets or launch posts for the next 2 hours. We don't want conflicting messaging. Also, pause automated inbound lead routing from the webhook that tags performance webinars.

jason_ops: Confirmed pause on routing isn't needed from Ops infra, Marketing can disable webhook. Ops will keep incident notes with scope (affected zones, model families) for internal CS.

amy_marketing: I'll post the English initial status at t+5 with Option A. Then assemble social-safe copy (no metrics, just status link) and an email draft for customers with active Dedicated contracts after t+15. Anyone want to own the email?

emily_support: I'll draft the two canned replies and an enterprise email template. Add a line: "If you notice degraded performance, please attach request IDs and we'll expedite." Also creating support tag `incident/eu-central-5xx`.

nina_legal: If customers ask about uptime credits, direct to the standard SLA page and loop Legal if they claim data loss. Keep records of sent communications for compliance.

amy_marketing: Owners: amy_marketing (post status + social-ready copy), emily_support (canned replies + CS notification), leo_growth (pause outbound campaigns & webinar notices), jason_ops (technical updates), nina_legal (watch wording). Posting initial status in 5.

leo_growth: Paused the automated webinar lead routing. Notifying events ops.

amy_marketing: (posted) https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/rdw-2026-047  initial update live (Option A).

emily_support: Canned replies uploaded to support repo; created tag incident/eu-central-5xx. Sending first proactive reach-outs to paying customers in 10m.

jason_ops: Reroute completed for affected rack at t+18, error rate down to baseline. Updating incident to "monitoring" now.

amy_marketing: Updating social queue: hold benchmark tweets for 1 hour and then manual review. Drafting post-incident messaging and postmortem template; will share in #postmortems channel.

ops-bot: Incident rdw-2026-047 status changed investigating -> monitoring at 2026-04-02T09:30:xxZ

leo_growth: Thanks team. After incident recap let's review impact on our benchmark narrative timeline and push any slides/claims to legal review if they reference uptime.

amy_marketing: Will schedule a 20m sync post-incident to finalize public postmortem blurb and marketing next steps.
